simple.meaning: גְּמוּלָה (gᵉmûwlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “meaning the same.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גְּמוּלָה (H1578) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 19:37, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּמוּלָה (H1578) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גְּמוּלָה (H1578) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גְּמוּלָה (gᵉmûwlâh) / H1578 is traced through 2 Samuel 19:37, Isaiah 59:18, Jeremiah 51:56 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
